o1.biggest_strength: A full 24-post calendar with titles, clear review flags on each draft, and correct install maths (450 vs 100 per post, 7,650 projected).
o1.biggest_mistake: It sends every sleep post to review, even wind-down posts that name no condition, so week 1 is six kindness posts and our best install driver waits a week.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Write week 1 sleep and wind-down posts that name no condition so they skip review, and tidy the clunky carousel copy.

o2.biggest_strength: Sleep posts and narrator clips start in week 1, worded so they need no review, with warm hooks from our customers (replaying emails, day three, pickup) and a small action at the end of every draft.
o2.biggest_mistake: It gives no post-by-post calendar for weeks 2 to 4 and no review-flagged draft, and it keeps four stress-at-work posts that could have been sleep posts.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add a dated title calendar for weeks 2 to 4 that marks which posts go to review, and move the stress slot toward sleep.

reason: Output 2 puts our best performer, evening sleep narrator clips, on air from day one without tripping review, and its drafts sound more like us. Output 1 is well organised but loses a whole week to over-caution.
